Epistemic Systems Lab

Human Brain Cell Cluster Reader

A readable view of the annotation tables published with Siletti et al., Transcriptomic diversity of cell types across the adult human brain (Science, 2023). Pick a supercluster, then a cluster, to read its card.

The authors group nuclei at three levels. They describe the subcluster level as more detailed and less robust than the cluster level, so cards are written per cluster and subclusters are listed inside each card. Cluster and subcluster numbers are identifiers from the clustering procedure.

Data: Siletti K. et al., Transcriptomic diversity of cell types across the adult human brain. Science 382, eadd7046 (2023). doi:10.1126/science.add7046.

Tables: cluster_annotation.xlsx, subcluster_annotation.xlsx and dissections.xlsx from linnarsson-lab/adult-human-brain. Code definitions from linnarsson-lab/auto-annotation-ah. Full expression data: CELLxGENE collection.

Every value shown is copied from those tables. Totals are sums over the tables. Nothing here assigns a function to a cluster.
